title: Passion fruit mousse
hookLine: Venezuela-inspired passion fruit mousse with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Add gelatin and ¼ cup room-temperature water to small bowl; let sit until gelatin softens, about 5 minutes. In medium saucepan over medium-high heat, stir together passion fruit pulp, sugar and gelatin mixture. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thoroughly combined and smooth (mixture should not come to a boil). Remove from heat; cool completely. Stir in condensed milk. Incorporate {m53333_1}, {m53333_2}, {m53333_3}, and {m53333_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure unflavoured gelatin first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, in clean mixing bowl, using electric mixer, beat egg whites until stiff (peaks of egg whites will not droop, and egg whites will not move when bowl is tilted). Incorporate {m53333_5} and {m53333_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Chill Until Firmly Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir 1/3 egg whites into cooled passion fruit mixture until combined. Using spatula, gently fold in remaining egg whites until combined. Divide mousse evenly among clear glass serving cups; cover. Refrigerate mousse until well chilled, at least 2 hrs.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve chilled. Garnish with mint, if desired. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
